title: Boot Configurator — MCP scan, VESA GUI, dynamic domain allocation
goals: Sprint 10-A: Hardware-agnostic MCP scan at boot (kernel/mcp.h)
Sprint 10-B: VESA linear framebuffer driver + 8x16 bitmap font (kernel/fb.h)
Sprint 10-C: Boot Configurator GUI — mode picker (AI/Game/General/Custom)
Sprint 10-D: Wire MCP + boot config into kernel_main — dynamic domain sizes
Sprint 10-E: Build, SCP, verify on VAIO — zero warnings, Sprint 10 PASS

mcp_scan.pci_scan: hardware-agnostic (class codes only, no vendor-ID decisions)

framebuffer.note: QEMU -nographic+VNC path: GRUB did not hand off a linear framebuffer tag. fb_available=0, headless path taken. GUI auto-skipped, GENERAL auto-selected. Full linear FB visible when booted on physical display or QEMU -display sdl.
framebuffer.grub_cfg_ready: set gfxmode=1024x768x32 / set gfxpayload=keep / insmod all_video

boot_configurator.result: PASS — config written and read back correctly

vaio_actual_boot.note: GENERAL mode bias doubles general domain: 32->64 MiB

results.final_verdict: Sprint 10 PASS -- Boot Configurator on bare metal

architecture_decisions.hardware_agnostic: MCP scanner uses PCI class codes (0x0300 VGA, 0x0106 AHCI, etc.) exclusively for capability decisions. Vendor/device IDs recorded in sam_mcp_t but not used for any branch. Same binary boots on Intel, AMD, NVIDIA hardware.
architecture_decisions.three_layer_model: microkernel (proves isolation) -> boot configurator (GUI config) -> personality (AI/Game/General). Configurator bridges boot-time hardware reality to kernel-time domain policy.
architecture_decisions.dynamic_domains: Domain sizes computed from detected RAM tier at boot, not hardcoded. VAIO 511 MB -> small tier (AI 64M, GAME 32M, GEN 64M). 8 GB machine -> large tier (AI 512M). Same binary adapts.
architecture_decisions.headless_safe: boot_config.h checks mcp.fb_available before any fb_ call. On serial-only / QEMU -nographic systems the GUI is silently skipped and GENERAL mode auto-selected.
architecture_decisions.config_handoff: sam_boot_config_t written to 0x7000 (below conventional memory hole). Magic 0xB007C0FF guards validity. kernel_main reads and falls back to Sprint 9 statics on mismatch.
architecture_decisions.font_engineering: 8x16 IBM CP437 bitmap embedded as static const uint8_t[96][16]. Single-brace initializer avoids GCC -Wextra 'braces around scalar' flood (96x16=1536 warnings fixed).

domain_sizing_policy.mode_bias: Primary domain doubled when RAM >= 512 MB and mode matches

paninian_correspondence.MCP_sutra: One hardware-query rule (class codes only) — Utsarga
paninian_correspondence.boot_configurator: GUI Paribhasha: sets constraints before kernel runs
paninian_correspondence.dynamic_domains: Avrtti: RAM tier policy applied uniformly across all modes
paninian_correspondence.headless_fallback: Lopa: GUI silently elided on headless systems
paninian_correspondence.mode_inheritance: Anuvrtti: selected mode propagated to all domain allocations
